query: The API is not responding, I need to restart the brain service
task_description: L4 procedural memory matching: given a task description, POST /skills/match should rank the most relevant skill first out of a benchmark fixture corpus.
test_steps: Benchmark run seeds fixture skills (restart + distractors) before procedural tasks
Verify the restart fixture skill ranks first
Verify a distractor is not the top result
Verify an unrelated control query ranks a different skill first
